title: Design System: Comissão de Formatura — Tesouraria & Rifas

label.purpose: Uppercase small-caps caption on stat tiles, table headers, receipt rows (.label-tag).

figures.purpose: Money, dates, IDs, raffle numbers — tabular Geist Mono, never proportional (.font-figures).

shadows.name: sticky-lift
shadows.purpose: Reservation summary bar pinned to the bottom of the purchase flow.

shadows.name: receipt-lift
shadows.purpose: Confirmation receipt card — soft two-layer shadow, never a hard offset.

shadows.name: selected-stub-lift
shadows.purpose: A selected raffle number stub, combined with a 2px upward translate.

shadows.name: hairline-ring
shadows.purpose: Default card depth at rest — a ring, not a shadow.

motion.name: stub-pulse
motion.value: box-shadow ripple, 0.9s ease-out, expanding from currentColor at 55% to 0% opacity
motion.purpose: One-shot ripple when a raffle number's status changes live while a buyer is looking at the grid.

motion.name: stamp-in
motion.purpose: The confirmed-state stamp landing with a slight overshoot, like a rubber stamp striking paper.

motion.name: receipt-feed
motion.purpose: The confirmation receipt's one authored entrance moment, like a thermal printer feeding paper.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Solid emerald action button — reservations, confirmations, submits.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.42 0.11 160); color: oklch(0.99 0.01 160); padding: 0.5rem 1rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 0.875rem; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.55 0.1 160); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; }

components.name: Stamp Badge — Confirmed
components.description: The confirmed-state signature mark: rotated, bordered, never a soft pill.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3em; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0.3rem; padding: 0.1em 0.55em; transform: rotate(-2deg); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-stamp-confirmed { color: oklch(0.42 0.11 160); }

components.name: Stamp Badge — Pending / Void
components.description: The other two states in the status vocabulary, same stamp shape, different hue.
components.css: .ds-stamp { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.3em; border: 1.5px solid currentColor; border-radius: 0.3rem; padding: 0.1em 0.55em; transform: rotate(-2deg); font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-stamp-pending { color: oklch(0.5 0.13 75); } .ds-stamp-void { color: oklch(0.48 0.16 30); }

components.name: Raffle Number Stub
components.description: The signature component: a ticket-stub button showing a tabular number over its status caption.
components.css: .ds-stub { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; border-radius: 0.4rem; border: 1px solid; padding: 0.625rem 0; font-family: ui-monospace, "Geist Mono"; } .ds-stub-num { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stub-label { margin-top: 0.125rem; font-size: 0.5625rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.03em; text-transform: uppercase; opacity: 0.7; } .ds-stub-confirmed { background: oklch(0.93 0.045 160); border-color: oklch(0.42 0.11 160 / 0.4); color: oklch(0.42 0.11 160); }

narrative.overview: This is a paper-and-ink system built from the physical vocabulary of a printed receipt sitting on a desk. Every confirmed action earns the same visual event a real receipt gets: a stamp, a dashed tear-line, a row of tabular figures that never wobble. The system replaces a generic admin-panel look with something that reads as evidence — a comprovante the committee and the buyer can both trust at a glance, because the buyer-facing raffle store and the committee's internal ledger are the same physical object seen from two sides of the counter. The ground is warm, slightly cream paper because paper has a hue; cards render a shade lighter than the page, catching light, lifted off the desk. Confirmed state reuses the brand emerald directly; pending and void are their own hues, not desaturated variants of it.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, graphite ink, one brand emerald that never dilutes into a generic accent blue
Dashed rules stand in for a receipt's perforated tear-line everywhere a divider is needed
Tabular Geist Mono for every number, date, and ID — money never wobbles in weight
A rotated, bordered stamp mark is the one signature confirmed-state device, reused identically on the buyer's receipt and the committee's status badges
Depth from a hairline ring, not drop shadows; shadows are reserved for things that are physically lifted

rules.name: The One Ledger Rule
rules.body: Confirmed, pending, and void are the only three status colors in the system. A new status reuses one of the three semantically rather than introducing a fourth hue.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Any number a person might scan down a column — money, quantities, dates — renders in .font-figures. A proportional-figure amount next to a tabular one is always a defect.

rules.name: The Min-Width-Zero Rule
rules.body: The admin shell's content column carries min-w-0. Without it, a single wide table blows out the entire flex row on narrow viewports instead of scrolling inside its own overflow-x-auto wrapper — a real, shipped bug this system already hit once.

rules.name: The Grid-Cols-1 Rule
rules.body: Any container using a responsive column count declares its base column count explicitly, never a bare grid. An implicit single-column grid track sizes to auto (max-content), so a truncate list item inside it silently forces the whole page wider than the viewport — a second real, shipped bug this system hit.

rules.name: No Flat Shadows
rules.body: This world is not neobrutalist. A box-shadow always carries blur; a zero-blur offset block shadow is a costume this system does not wear.

dos: Do render every money amount, date, ID fragment, and raffle number in .font-figures.
Do use .receipt-divider (dashed) for row and section separators instead of solid border-b.
Do collapse a KPI row into one divide-dashed card instead of N separately bordered stat tiles.
Do give the admin shell's content column min-w-0, and give every responsive grid an explicit grid-cols-1 base.
Do use grid-cols-[repeat(auto-fit,minmax(Npx,1fr))] for card grids that might render a single item.
Do use the stamp badge mode for any confirmed/void state that is the point of the row.
donts: Don't use a flat, zero-blur box-shadow — this world's depth is a hairline ring plus soft blur, never a hard offset.
Don't put a kicker or eyebrow label directly above a heading as a category tag.
Don't use a colored border-left/border-right on cards, list items, or alerts.
Don't repeat the icon-plus-heading-plus-text card as page scaffolding.
Don't introduce a fourth status color.
